name: 13790 · Johnson City, NY
findings: ZIP 13790 (Johnson City) has 68 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13790 (Johnson City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 13790 (Johnson City) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
